component.name: AdminZone
component.summary: Pair customers of AbraFlexi with their IPEX, Subreg and SledovaniTV accounts

description.p: AbraFlexi AdminZone is a web-based administration tool for AbraFlexi operators. Sign in with your AbraFlexi account and assign accounts of external services to customers stored in AbraFlexi by external ID (EXT:id).

ul.li: Sign in with an AbraFlexi authentication token, including one-time passwords
Data grids of IPEX, Subreg and SledovaniTV accounts with suggestions of the customer to pair
Pairing is stored in AbraFlexi and reported back to the external service
Customer list and address card with an overview of connected services

description.p: Stricter check of the access to the configured company at sign-in.

ul.li: Sign-in is refused when the access of the AbraFlexi account to the company cannot be verified
Any AbraFlexi user may sign in unless ABRAFLEXI_ALLOWED_USERS restricts it

description.p: Fixes the empty account lists and adds a service account option.

ul.li: Account grids work again (jQuery was missing on the pages)
Optional service account for data calls with an allow list of operators
AbraFlexi server and company shown in the menu; clearer errors from IPEX, Subreg and SledovaniTV

description.p: The application now focuses on pairing external service accounts with AbraFlexi customers.

ul.li: New look shared with AbraFlexi ClientZone, new logo
Removed features moved to dedicated projects (orders, reminders, matcher, webhooks, digests)
Sign in with an AbraFlexi token
Assignment of IPEX, Subreg and SledovaniTV accounts to AbraFlexi customers
